route: Work visa and work permit (Ministry of Foreign Affairs and Immigration; Immigration Act 2019, Immigration Procedures 2020)

permit.applies: The worker lodges the work visa application on the Ministry of Foreign Affairs and Immigration's form, with the fee; the work permit file also holds the request letter, the employment contract and, for a private business, its localisation plan and advertisement.
permit.first: A genuine offer of employment stating the pay, hours, conditions and duration; for an Essential Skills work visa, the employer's genuine attempt to recruit Kiribati citizens or residents, none being available; for a Specific Purpose or Event work visa (media, film and video production crew among its purposes), the production's terms, its duration included.

fees.what: Work permit application form, single journey
Work permit fee (paid to the Ministry of Finance and Economic Development)
Work permit security bond (refunded at the permit's end)

permit.eligibility: Suitably qualified by training and experience for the job offered, of acceptable health and good character, with funds for maintenance: a salary an immigration officer finds sufficient, the employer's guarantee, own funds, or a sponsor in Kiribati.
permit.pay: The employer must pay no less than the minimum wage, and the salary must, in the immigration officer's view, cover maintenance and accommodation unless the employer guarantees them.
permit.feesNote: The application form costs AUD 80 for multiple journeys instead of 40.
permit.processingNote: The trade portal gives 10 to 30 working days; the longer is held.
permit.validityNote: An Essential Skills work visa is granted for 1 year, further visas for the period the employment is offered, up to 3 years in all; a Specific Purpose or Event work visa for media, film and video production crew runs for the period of engagement, further visas granted with evidence of the need.

sources.title: Kiribati Immigration, Work Visa Application Form (2020; saved l4w/files/p1c/KI-workvisa.pdf)
sources.said: You should use this form if you are applying for the following work visa types: • Essential Skills • Religious worker • Specific purpose or event • Domestic worker of consulate staff … All applicants must provide: • Completed, signed application form • Appropriate fee (Contact visaofficer@mfa.gov.ki for details on payment, or go to www.mfa.gov.ki/immigration for more information). … • A job offer, including a job description, details of pay, and conditions of the proposed employment … Applicants for Specific Purpose or Event work visas must also provide • Description of the specific purpose or event for which I am coming to Kiribati • Evidence of the specific purpose or event

sources.title: Kiribati Ministry of Foreign Affairs and Immigration, Immigration Procedures, certified under the Immigration Act 2019, Version 1 (128 pp., 2020), section D 'Temporary Visas: Work Visas' (saved l4w/files/p1c/KI-proc.pdf)
sources.said: Work means any activity undertaken for gain or reward … 2. Requirements for work visa applicants Unless specifically stated, all work visa applicants must: … b. produce evidence to show that they are suitably qualified by training and experience to do the job they have been offered. … sufficient funds for maintenance. This includes showing at least one of the following: a. a proposed salary that an immigration officer considers sufficient to cover maintenance and accommodation … 3. General requirements for employers … a. paying employees no less than the minimum wage … 5. Offers of employment All offers of employment must be genuine and sustainable and should contain: … iii. details of pay, hours of work and conditions of employment … 11. Essential Skills work visa … may only be granted if: a. the employment is acceptable b. there are no Kiribati citizens or residents available for the work … 13. Currency of Essential Skills work visas An Essential Skills work visa may be granted for 1 year. Further visas may be granted for the period for which the employment is offered, up to a maximum of 3 years. … 15. Specific Purpose or Event work visa … c. the work is time-bound (not permanent or open) d. the applicant is suitably qualified to undertake the work e. the applicant has an approved sponsor (if applicable) … Media, film and video production crew | Terms of production, including duration | For period of engagement | Further visas can be granted with evidence of need for extension
